name: Sum Technology Berhad
overview: Sum Technology Berhad 于2026年在马来西亚交易所 ACE Market 上市，并完成收购 INI Technologies Sdn. Bhd. 51% 股权（现金代价 RM2,000,000），将该公司纳入集团。其他业务板块在公告中未见具体动态。
overview_en: Sum Technology Berhad listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia in 2026 and completed the acquisition of a 51% equity interest in INI Technologies Sdn. Bhd. for a cash consideration of RM2,000,000, bringing the company into the group. No specific developments were announced for the other business segments.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成收购 INI Technologies 51% 股权，该公司成为集团子公司。
segments.note_en: Completed the acquisition of a 51% equity interest in INI Technologies this year, making it a subsidiary of the group.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购 INI Technologies Sdn. Bhd. 51% 股权的事项已完成。
actions.text_en: The acquisition of a 51% equity interest in INI Technologies Sdn. Bhd. has been completed.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 签订股份出售协议，以现金 RM2,000,000 收购 INI Technologies Sdn. Bhd. 51% 股权（255,000 股普通股）。
actions.text_en: Entered into a share sale agreement to acquire 255,000 ordinary shares in INI Technologies Sdn. Bhd., representing 51% of its issued share capital, for a cash consideration of RM2,000,000.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过收购 INI Technologies 51% 股权，集团将该公司纳入合并范围，新增子公司。
model_changes.text_en: Through the acquisition of a 51% equity interest in INI Technologies, the group consolidated the company as a new subsidiary.
